Score each supplied baseline measurement for its expected predictive usefulness for this task using only the measurement descriptions and task description (no patient records or labels). Assign each field ID a floating-point relevance score in [0.0, 1.0] (1.0 = most useful, 0.0 = irrelevant). Return strict JSON with the single top-level key "scores" mapping every supplied field ID to its numeric score.
{"task": "Estimate a recurrence-free survival event within two years after breast cancer surgery using available baseline indicators.", "fields": {"F0": {"description": "hormonal therapy indicator", "name": "horTh"}, "F2": {"description": "menopausal status", "name": "menostat"}, "F3": {"description": "tumour size", "name": "tsize"}, "F4": {"description": "histological tumour grade", "name": "tgrade"}, "F1": {"description": "age in years", "name": "age"}, "F6": {"description": "progesterone receptor level", "name": "progrec"}, "F7": {"description": "estrogen receptor level", "name": "estrec"}, "F5": {"description": "number of positive lymph nodes", "name": "pnodes"}}}
